en.title: The Lights of the Tenement and a Meddlesome Will
en.premise: Kuma-san, the stubborn patriarch of the tenement, left behind a "meddlesome will"—and not a single coin to go with it. Instead, the document contained a series of peculiar requests for his neighbors. As Hachigoro, a young craftsman, and the sharp-tongued Osetsu bicker their way through these tasks, they begin to uncover the deep affection Kuma-san hid and the enduring bonds that tie the community together.

zh.title: 长屋的灯火与爱管闲事的遗言
zh.premise: 长屋的顽固老头熊先生留下的，是一份分文未给的“爱管闲事的遗嘱”。其中记载的，是给邻居们的诸多奇妙的“请求”。年轻的工匠八五郎与毒舌的节在吵吵闹闹地执行遗嘱的过程中，逐渐揭开了熊先生隐藏在内心深处的深情，以及长屋居民之间深厚的羁绊。
